about: Records from the first pass's unresolved list (batch-1/India_Heat_Action_Plans_Unresolved.csv) that a later pass verified. Each maps the old unresolved id to the verified record that replaces it, so the gap is no longer shown. Source: India_HAP_Batch_2_Coverage_Report.md, 'Verification and important corrections' (Pimpri-Chinchwad 2024, Himachal Pradesh 2024 and Uttar Pradesh 2024 recovered).
